title: Flood certification (FEMA Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form)

form_number.description: FEMA form number printed in the footer, e.g. FF-206-FY-21-116.

omb_expiration_date.description: OMB control number expiration date printed in the header, as YYYY-MM-DD.

lender.description: Section I, box 1: the lender or servicer the determination was made for.

address.description: Lender or servicer address, as one line.

customer_number.description: Customer number the preparer assigns to the lender.

collateral.description: Section I, box 2: the building or property securing the loan.

apn_tax_id.description: APN or tax ID, or null if blank.

flood_insurance_amount_required.description: Section I, box 5: amount of flood insurance required in USD, or null if blank.

nfip_community.description: Section II.A: the NFIP community jurisdiction.

nfip_map.description: Section II.B: NFIP data affecting the building.

map_panel_number.description: NFIP map number or community-panel number.

map_panel_effective_date.description: NFIP map panel effective or revised date, exactly as printed.

letter_of_map_change.description: True if the YES box for a Letter of Map Change (LOMC) is selected, false if NO is selected.

lomc_date.description: LOMC date as YYYY-MM-DD, or null if blank.

lomc_case_number.description: LOMC case number, or null if blank.

flood_zone.description: Flood zone designation, e.g. X, AE, VE.

no_nfip_map.description: True if the No NFIP Map box is checked.

insurance_availability.description: Section II.C: federal flood insurance availability checkboxes.

federal_insurance_available.description: Box 1 checked: community participates in the NFIP.

program.description: Which NFIP program box is checked, Regular or Emergency.

federal_insurance_not_available.description: Box 2 checked: community does not participate in the NFIP.

in_cbra_or_opa.description: Box 3 checked: building is in a Coastal Barrier Resources Area or Otherwise Protected Area.

in_special_flood_hazard_area.description: Section II.D determination: the checked answer, YES or NO, to whether the building is in a Special Flood Hazard Area.

life_of_loan_determination.description: True if the comments state this is a life of loan determination.

hmda.description: HMDA information block in the comments section.

determination_date.description: Date of determination, exactly as printed in Section F.

determination_fee.description: Fee charged for the determination in USD, if shown.

borrower_notice_type.description: Which notice is checked on the Notice of Special Flood Hazards page.
